hero.name: Michael Dever & Associates
hero.headline: From Translation to Trust
hero.subtitle: Confidence in your financial and corporate communications
hero.intro1: Your communications carry your reputation. You need to know that they are accurate, convey your intended message and stand up to scrutiny — in every language in which you publish.
hero.intro2: Michael Dever & Associates provides specialist English translation, writing, editing and independent review for finance, investor relations and corporate communications.
hero.intro3: Whether we produce your texts or review work prepared elsewhere, we bring the expertise and judgement you need to publish with confidence. For multilingual projects, we coordinate with trusted colleagues who apply the same care in their own languages.

work.heading: What we do
work.p1: We help you communicate clearly with investors, shareholders, analysts, clients and other stakeholders. Our work covers annual and interim reports, earnings releases, investor presentations, sustainability disclosures, websites and speeches.
work.p2: You can entrust us with a text from the outset or bring us in to assess and refine an existing draft. We examine the substance as well as the language: terminology, consistency, tone and the meaning your audience will take away.
work.p3: An independent review before publication can catch errors and ambiguities that earlier stages have missed. It also gives you access to specialist advice without changing your existing production arrangements.

ai.heading: Artificial intelligence and confidentiality
ai.p1: Producing a draft has become easier. Knowing whether it is fit to publish still requires expertise.
ai.p2: We help you assess and improve texts produced by people or AI, applying professional judgement to their accuracy, clarity and suitability for your audience. The depth of review is agreed with you, taking account of the purpose of the text and the consequences of getting it wrong.
ai.p3: We use technology selectively where it adds value and is compatible with your confidentiality requirements. We can also work entirely without AI. Your information is handled with care throughout the assignment.

clients.heading: Clients
clients.p1: We work with banks, insurers, non-financial companies, regulators, public bodies and professional services firms across Switzerland.
clients.p2: Our clients turn to us for specialist language skills, informed advice and an independent view of communications that matter to their business. We work alongside internal teams and existing providers, giving you additional expertise where you need it.

about.heading: About us
about.p1: Michael Dever & Associates has served the Swiss business community since 2006.
about.p2: We combine experience in financial services with specialist language expertise and a close understanding of corporate communications. Our network brings together trusted professionals who understand both the subjects they work on and the audiences they write for.
about.p3: Long-standing client relationships are built on that combination: knowledge of your business, careful attention to your words and the confidence to flag what needs a second look.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.intro: Need a text translated, a draft improved or an independent opinion before publication? Let’s discuss where expert support would be most useful.
